about.title: About
about.intro: I'm Dragoș Cătălin. I build products end to end — from cloud and network to the app in your pocket. I started coding at about ten, got paid for it at fifteen and have shipped for a living ever since.

items.title: Verify, don't assume
items.body: Nothing is done until the verifying command ran and I saw the output. Preregistered thresholds in research, frozen test vectors in crypto, deflated Sharpe in trading.

items.title: Money must balance
items.body: Double-entry ledgers, immutable journal entries and hash-chained audit logs — in an ERP and in a game economy alike.

items.title: Every surface
items.body: Web, desktop, mobile, extension, MCP, SDK. A feature isn't finished until every consumer has it.

items.title: Latest stable, always
items.body: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 7, Tailwind 4, Rust/Tauri 2. Upgrade early, upgrade in slices.

items.title: Agent-native
items.body: Rules, skills, hooks and memory for the AI agents I work with, so they decide with me — not for me.

items.title: Romania first, EU ready
items.body: e-Factura, ANAF, SAF-T, RON and BNR rates. Everything bilingual.

I take on few projects, and I finish them.

privacy.title: Privacy & cookies
privacy.intro: What this site stores, why, for how long, and how to change your mind. Last updated 5 October 2026.
privacy.storageTitle: What is stored on your device

rows.theme: Remembers dark/light mode, accent and surface.
rows.vercel: Anonymous page views and Core Web Vitals. Sets no cookies; loads only after you accept analytics.

privacy.contact: When you send a message, your name, email and message are processed only to reply to you (legitimate interest / steps before a contract, GDPR art. 6(1)(b) and (f)). The message is delivered through Brivio, my own mail platform hosted in the EU, and an invisible anti-bot check from Vercel BotID runs when you send it; no third-party widget is loaded. Messages are kept for as long as the conversation lasts, then for at most 2 years.
privacy.hosting: The site is hosted on Vercel. Their servers keep short-lived technical logs (IP address, user agent) for security and abuse prevention, as every web server does.
privacy.rights: You may ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or object to processing, and you may withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier processing. You may also complain to ANSPDCP (dataprotection.ro).
privacy.change: Open the cookie settings to change or withdraw your consent. Withdrawing reloads the page so that analytics stops immediately.
privacy.newsletter: If you subscribe, your email address, language, the consent wording version and the time of consent are stored in Brivio, my own mail platform hosted in the EU (GDPR art. 6(1)(a), consent). Your IP is kept only as a salted hash, as proof of consent. Nothing is sent until you click the confirmation link (double opt-in). Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link; after you leave, the address is kept only as an unsubscribed record so you are never written to again.

feedbrake.title: Feedbrake
feedbrake.tagline: Brakes for the infinite feed — not for the app.
feedbrake.intro: Feedbrake blocks only the infinite short-video feed: TikTok For You, Instagram Reels and Home, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels. It does not block the app. Messages, search, profiles and the camera keep working.

features.title: A limit per app
features.body: For each app, pick how much feed you allow: blocked, N minutes a day or N videos a day.

features.title: Three blocking styles
features.body: Shield, Cover or Redirect. Swipes and volume keys stop moving to the next video; tabs and the rest of the app still work.

features.title: Pause with friction
features.body: Pausing protection takes a deliberate step, so a reflex is not enough to turn it off.

features.title: Focus sessions and schedules
features.body: Start a strict focus session with no pauses, or set the hours when feeds are blocked.

features.title: Quick Settings tile and widget
features.body: See and change protection from the notification shade or the home screen.

features.title: Weekly report
features.body: Once a week, a short summary of how many feeds were blocked and how much time they took.

privacy: No account, no ads, no analytics, no crash reporting.
Everything is processed and stored on your phone.
The detection rules are public and cryptographically signed, so you can read exactly what the app looks for.
feedbrake.contact: Questions, bugs or a feed that slipped through? Write to {email}.

feedbrakePrivacy.title: Feedbrake — Privacy policy
feedbrakePrivacy.meta: Feedbrake processes everything on your phone: no account, no analytics, no ads, no personal data leaves the device.
feedbrakePrivacy.byline: Effective: {date} · Publisher: Dragoș Cătălin Vlădulescu · Contact: {email}
feedbrakePrivacy.intro: Feedbrake blocks infinite short-video feeds (TikTok, Instagram Reels and Home, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Reels) on your phone. It is built so that no personal data leaves your device.
feedbrakePrivacy.accessTitle: What the app accesses and why
feedbrakePrivacy.a11y: Feedbrake uses it only to recognise when one of the supported apps is showing an infinite feed, to place a shield over that feed, to pass your taps through to the app, and to handle the volume keys while a feed is blocked. The service reads the structure of the screen (element types, ids and positions) of the supported apps only while protection is active. It does not read your messages, does not record the screen, does not log what you type and does not store or send any screen content. This use is disclosed in the app before you enable the service, and the service only works after you give consent.
stored: Daily counters per app: number of blocks, videos watched under a limit, minutes spent in a feed, swipes blocked, pauses and whether protection was turned off.
feedbrakePrivacy.storedNote: You can export these settings, import them or delete the statistics in Settings at any time. Uninstalling the app removes everything.
feedbrakePrivacy.backup: If you have Android backup turned on, your settings and counters are included in your own Google backup, encrypted by Android. Feedbrake has no access to that backup.
feedbrakePrivacy.network: The only network request is an optional daily download of the public detection rules from {host}. The file is cryptographically signed and is checked before use. The request contains no identifiers beyond what any HTTPS request carries (IP address, seen by GitHub). You can turn it off in Settings.
feedbrakePrivacy.not: No account, no analytics, no advertising, no crash reporting, no selling or sharing of data, no data collected about children. The app does not collect any data as defined by Google Play's Data safety section.
feedbrakePrivacy.changes: If this policy changes, the new version will be published at this address with a new effective date.
